name: LightSpace
tagline: A local-first photography workspace for desktop and browser
summary: LightSpace is a shared Uno desktop/WebAssembly photography application: browse a local catalog, develop a photograph, refine its composition and masks, and export a rendered copy while the original bytes stay untouched. A dark workspace combines a library sidebar, photo canvas, filmstrip, histogram and development inspector, powered by GPU-capable SkSL effects and eight reusable C# libraries.

highlights.title: Non-destructive development
highlights.text: Light, white balance, vibrance, curves, eight color bands and effects are stored as settings; original encoded bytes are never modified.

highlights.title: Local photo catalog
highlights.text: Import, search, rate, flag and group photos into albums in a paged grid and filmstrip that runs entirely on your device.

highlights.title: Four-way color grading
highlights.text: Shadow, midtone, highlight and global wheels with luminance, blending and balance controls.

highlights.title: Arbitrary RGB curves
highlights.text: Master, red, green and blue curves with up to 32 points each and linear or shape-preserving smooth interpolation.

highlights.title: Masks and brushes
highlights.text: Radial and linear gradients, luminance and sampled Oklab color ranges, and pressure-aware brush masks with local adjustments.

highlights.title: GPU-capable SkSL effects
highlights.text: Compiled SkSL runtime effects render inside Uno's Skia composition path, with software rendering for tests and export.

highlights.title: XMP sidecars
highlights.text: Import and export standard metadata and a reported Camera Raw subset, with a native extension for full LightSpace round trips.

highlights.title: Content-addressed recovery
highlights.text: Originals stored under SHA-256 keys, atomically published edit manifests and integrity checks on restore.

items: Import JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP or the first GIF frame, retaining original bytes
Paged grid, detail view and filmstrip with 60-photo pages
Search filenames, captions and keywords
Ratings, pick/reject flags and albums
Copy/paste and sync development settings across selected photos
Light, relative white balance, vibrance/saturation and monochrome
Eight-band HSV color mixer with hue, saturation and luminance
Four-way color grading with blending and balance
Creative presets, texture/clarity/dehaze approximations and sharpening
Spatial smoothing, vignette and grain; double-click resets a slider
Master, red, green and blue curves with up to 32 points per channel
Linear or shape-preserving smooth interpolation
Add, drag and delete points or type Input/Output values
2048-entry floating-point lookup cache reused across unrelated edits
Free crop rectangles with handles, centered ratios, quarter turns and flips
Up to 32 feathered clone stamps from an explicit Alt-click source
Original view and a draggable before/after divider
Fit, source-pixel 100% zoom and wheel zoom around the pointer
Up to eight masks with enable, amount, inversion, rename and duplicate
Rotatable radial and linear gradients with on-canvas handles
Luminance ranges and up to five sampled Oklab color pins
Pressure-aware brush masks with size, feather, flow and density
Local exposure, contrast, temperature, tint and saturation
One transaction per gesture with 100-step undo/redo and named versions
Export 8-bit sRGB JPEG, PNG or WebP copies or a ZIP of a selection
Portable .lightspace catalogs with originals, edits, albums and versions
XMP sidecar import with a compatibility report before applying
IndexedDB or native recovery with source integrity checks and retry

packages.name: LightSpace.Core
packages.role: Photo state, grading, curves/interpolation, masks, brush samples, geometry and presets

packages.name: LightSpace.Catalog
packages.role: Schema migration, serialization, queries and XMP metadata/settings interchange

packages.name: LightSpace.Editing
packages.role: Gesture transactions, bounded undo/redo, versions, synchronization and revision-aware recovery

packages.name: LightSpace.Imaging
packages.role: Bounded decoding, EXIF orientation, sRGB conversion and fallback artwork

packages.name: LightSpace.Rendering.Skia
packages.role: SkSL runtime effects, image cache, curve tables, incremental brush coverage, histogram and export

packages.name: LightSpace.Storage
packages.role: Import/export contracts, atomic native recovery store and optional sidecar-picker capability

packages.name: LightSpace.Controls
packages.role: Original Uno chrome, icons, sliders, grading/mixer/curve/mask/brush controls and photo canvas

packages.name: LightSpace.Workbench
packages.role: Composable workspace, inspectors, commands, dialogs and save UX

codeSamples.title: Embed processing
Build and run
codeSamples.code:
git clone https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/LightSpace.git
cd LightSpace
python3 scripts/fetch-assets.py
dotnet workload install wasm-tools --skip-manifest-update

# Model, processing, lifetime, recovery, XMP and performance checks
dotnet run --project tests/LightSpace.Engine.Tests -c Release

# Shared native desktop host
dotnet run --project src/LightSpace.App -f net10.0-desktop \
  -p:LightSpaceDesktopOnly=true

# Actual Uno WebAssembly publication
dotnet publish src/LightSpace.App -f net10.0-browserwasm -c Release \
  -o artifacts/publish -p:WasmShellWebAppBasePath=/LightSpace/
python3 scripts/collect-site.py artifacts/publish artifacts/site
python3 scripts/serve-site.py --directory artifacts/site --port 4173

shortcuts.keys: Ctrl/Cmd I / Ctrl/Cmd S / Ctrl/Cmd E

playground.intro: Open the live WebAssembly build and develop the demonstration catalog — every edit is non-destructive and stays on your device.

tour.title: Browse the catalog
tour.text: Press G for the grid, rate photos with 0–5, flag picks with P, and search by filename, caption or keyword.

tour.title: Develop a photo
tour.text: Press E to open Edit, drag Light and Color sliders, double-click a slider to reset it, and press Escape to cancel a gesture.

tour.title: Shape curves and grades
tour.text: Open RGB curves and click to add points on the master or a color channel, then open Grade to tint shadows and highlights.

tour.title: Add a local mask
tour.text: Press M, add a radial or linear gradient or sample a color range with click/Shift-click, then adjust local exposure.

tour.title: Compare before and after
tour.text: Press Y for the before/after view and drag the divider, or press Backslash to toggle the original.

tour.title: Export a copy
tour.text: Press Ctrl/Cmd+E to export a JPEG, PNG or WebP copy, or Ctrl/Cmd+S to save a portable catalog backup.

architecture.name: Photo model
architecture.text: Immutable photo state, adjustments, curves, masks and geometry with no Uno dependency.

architecture.name: Catalog, imaging and storage
architecture.text: Versioned catalog serialization and XMP, bounded Skia decoding, and platform-independent storage contracts.

architecture.name: Editing and rendering
architecture.text: Gesture transactions, undo and versions alongside SkSL development, masks, histogram and export.

architecture.name: Uno UI
architecture.text: Original photography controls composed into a reusable workspace for browser and desktop hosts.

boundaries: Independent early-stage software, not a pixel-identical or feature-complete Lightroom replacement
No RAW/DNG/HEIF/TIFF decoding, AI tools, HDR/panorama merging or calibrated camera/lens correction
Output is 8-bit sRGB up to an 8192 px long edge; source EXIF/IPTC is not embedded in copies
Brush mask coverage is capped at a 1024-pixel long edge, even for export
Recovery is local and unencrypted — not cloud sync or a substitute for original-file backups
